lines.text: Objective is lost, Command, please advise!
I need an evac now.  Now, dammit, now!
We've lost contact with Raptor and Venom squads.
They're all over us!  Oh god - (Static)
It's no good, Command.  We're gonna have to take the alternate route.
We're taking heavy fire, we've lost two port thrusters, and.
This isn't an assault, Command.  It's a fucking massacre.
They won't stop coming!  We've killed hundreds, they keep coming!

lines.notes: m04_stranarus_trench/4_5_2.wav may already be this line: listen first

lines.text: Tiger squad, fall back.  Fall back!
lines.notes: m04_stranarus_trench/4_5_3.wav may already be this line: listen first

lines.text: Raptor squad is down.  They ambushed us.  I'm the only one left, the entire squad was wiped out.
Command, where is our fucking support?

lines.notes: recorded take vo_marks_getmov has the same words
no recorded take: needs his voice

lines.text: You have your orders, Sergeant.  Find a way behind those turrets.
lines.notes: recorded take vo_marks_youhaveords is close
m04_stranarus_trench/4_5_4.wav may already be this line: listen first
m04_stranarus_trench/4_5_5.wav may already be this line: listen first

lines.text: Eastern approach is stalled.  They've got us pinned in.  We're not gonna last long.
We've breached the Northern wall.  We're 'go' for infiltration.
Mongoose squad is in position, awaiting further orders, Command.
It's a clusterfuck, Command, two squads killed right in front of me.  We need an updated sitrep.  Now!
They're all dead!  All of'em.  I'm not letting'em take me, Command.  You hear me?  They won't take me! (Gunshot)
Oh shit!  They're taking us apart.  Twelfth mobile division was just fucking incinerated. You copy, Command?
